includes.comment: JNA's bundled native helper, packed at com/sun/jna/<arch>/. Without this entry native-image strips them and Keyring.create() fails with UnsatisfiedLinkError on every platform.

java-keyring 1.0.4 ships its macOS Keychain JNI helper at the JAR root as osxkeychain.so (not under com/github/javakeyring). The static path keeps native-image from stripping it during the resource scan.

SSO-2873 — bundled example recipes the RecipeInterpreter reads from the classpath at runtime (examples/recipes/<id>/recipe.json). native-image strips un-referenced resources, so list them explicitly. JSON (not YAML) is shipped so the runtime needs no YAML parser.
SSO-2872 — the recipe schema, bundled for reference/validation.

SSO-2948 — the connection contract schema, bundled beside the recipe schema for reference/validation. Referenced by ConnectionSchemaConformanceTest; native-image strips un-referenced resources so it must be listed explicitly.
